_why: Originals of the two operations whose unguarded [0] on the Needs Interpreter checkbox field took down swat-project-nomination on 2026-09-09. Restore by PUTting either object back to /app/integrator/api/connections/1415539c-bb98-48bb-ad33-11be25189ad0/operations/<id>.
_incident: Needs Interpreter is dataType json (a checkbox), so its value is an array. Indexing [0] on a family that never had the field set throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 0)'. system_integration_v1 and the form page-content resolver both surface that as a hard failure, so ONE bad family row prevented the whole nomination form from rendering.
